description: Turns a measurement into a national cost range for a trade. For roof trades, pass the building footprint and the pitch - the roof surface multiplier is applied for you. Returns the range, the per-unit rates, what drives the price, and the limits of the estimate.

measurement.description: Square feet, or linear feet for perimeter trades such as fencing and gutters.

pitch_rise.description: Roof rise per 12 inches of run, e.g. 6 for a 6/12 roof. Roof trades only. Defaults to 6.

trade.description: Trade id or name, e.g. roofing, fencing, artificial-turf.

name: estimate_cost
title: Ballpark a job from a measurement
